description: This file defines a utility struct 'RecordedConnectionIssue' used for recording, managing, and notifying connection issues within a system that likely involves distributed or networked components. It provides methods for recording issues, resolving them, and delaying retries, and interacts with listener and service interfaces.

classes.name: RecordedConnectionIssue
classes.description: A struct for recording and managing connection issues, including notifying listeners and handling delay logic before retries.

methods.name: Record
methods.description: Records a new connection issue, updates timestamp and failure counts, computes retry delay, and notifies listener.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves the current issue if any, notifies listener of resolution, and clears the issue.

methods.name: DelayBeforeRetry
methods.description: Asynchronously delays execution based on the retry delay if there's a recorded issue.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the current issue or an empty string if none.
